meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要用 Python 处理天文观测数据或天体物理数值计算。
copy.tagline_en: Compute astronomical data with units, coordinates, and FITS in Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with astronomical observations or astrophysics data in Python.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Astropy 的 Python API 编写天文数据分析代码:单位与量纲换算、天球坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、表格操作、时间系统转换,以及 WCS 和宇宙学计算。
howto.when: 当你要求实现或调试基于 Astropy 的天文数据分析代码,涉及坐标转换、单位换算、FITS 文件处理等任务时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes astronomy data-analysis code with Astropy's Python API: unit and quantity conversion, celestial coordinate transforms, FITS I/O, tables, time scales, WCS and cosmology.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask Claude to implement or debug astronomical data-analysis code built on Astropy, such as coordinate transforms, unit conversion, or FITS handling.
